facts.fact: The Haute Autorité de la Communication's decision N°016/HAC/P/2026 of 25 April 2026, effective immediately, has article 17 strictly forbidding AI-manipulated deceptive content and deepfakes in private media coverage of the 31 May 2026 elections, with sanctions up to suspension from the campaign.

GIN.note: Document states nothing on this question for Guinea.
